description: This file contains unit tests for Deep Links security in the OpenClawKit project, focusing on gateway connection URLs and setup codes, verifying handling of insecure hosts and loopback addresses.

classes.name: DeepLinksSecurityTests
classes.description: A suite of security tests for deep link URLs related to the OpenClawKit application.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a gateway deep link URL with a non-loopback host and insecure tls is rejected.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Tests that a gateway deep link URL with a bypass host that is not localhost is rejected.

methods.name: gatewayDeepLinkAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Tests that a gateway deep link URL with a loopback address and insecure tls is accepted.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecureNonLoopbackWs
methods.description: Verifies that a setup code with a non-loopback ws URL is rejected.

methods.name: setupCodeRejectsInsecurePrefixBypassHost
methods.description: Verifies that a setup code with a bypass host is rejected.

methods.name: setupCodeAllowsLoopbackWs
methods.description: Checks that a setup code with a loopback ws URL is accepted.
